keep_clear.why: The brief asked for about 150 and to argue it. The hard floor is smaller: a temple's clear pass replaces #minecraft:logs and #minecraft:leaves in its box, so its box must stay out of an elder's canopy, whose reach is 36 (tools/elder_trees.py: crown radius 19 + limb reach 17), and out of the elder's Habitat Block spawn_range of 16 (data/habitat_blocks.json): 52. 150 holds instead to the keeper's numbers, because the heart of the island is a named resident: data/far_south.json build.keeper spawn_radius 96 is the distance at which a keeper brings a resident in, and Split-Bark's leash is 28 (data/resident_encounters.json split_bark build.leash), so a temple nearer than 124 would have a player at its cache wake the island's heart; 150 adds the largest temple's half-extent and a little. It is applied to every entry, so each temple is its own find and not a footnote to another landmark. Measured from every written column (and clear) to the entry's box or point.

temples.name: the Ring Court
temples.kind: a temple with a puzzle and a hidden cache: an eye in a ring of stones that opens
temples.situation: On a level terrace in the west of the jungle, a raised court of mossy stone nineteen blocks square, a step up from the forest floor, with a sanctum in the middle whose north-east corner has fallen in: a jungle tree grows up through the hole and its crown roofs what the stone no longer does. Vines hang down the walls. Inside, eight carved stones are set in the floor in a ring round a plain one, and a sign on the west wall says the ring has an eye that opens. The eye is a trapdoor under the moss. Below it a ladder goes down into a room of carved stone with a ring cut in each wall, and a barrel set in its floor.
temples.story_rule: SQ-JUNGLE-01's ring symbols and its one hidden cache, and SQ-SUNSET-02's overgrown site. The signs never name the Rift or the Compact; the rings are only rings.

temples.name: the Harbour Mark
temples.kind: a sea-mark on a hilltop, its arm still pointing home, and a cache: the sailors' offering stone
temples.situation: On the high terrace in the middle of the jungle, at y147 the highest flat ground for half a kilometre, a stepped stone plinth carries an obelisk with a stone arm at its top pointing due west. Round it, ten blocks out, the stumps of a colonnade stand at every height, and one column lies where it fell. The sign on the obelisk's west face is a harbour's mark; the one on its east face asks a coin of whoever passes. On the plinth's east edge one stone is a box.

temples.name: the Green Stair
temples.kind: a stepped pyramid whose front stair fell, a climb the jungle made, and a cache on the summit altar
temples.situation: In the north of the jungle, on a terrace at y146, a stepped pyramid of three tiers rises out of the trees, seventeen blocks across at the foot. A stair climbs the south face of the first two tiers; the third tier's stair has fallen, and only a stub and a heap of rubble are left at its foot, with a sign that says the green one grew another. Round the back, vines three wide hang the whole height of the top tier. On the summit four posts carry half a roof over an altar with a pot on it, and a jungle tree grows out of the second tier's north-east corner, its crown above the shrine.
temples.story_rule: the third of the jungle's ruins: no quest of its own (SQ-SUNSET-02's tropical lead may point here). The altar's sign is a dedication, not a clue to anything beyond the climb.
